name: moonbit_linalg
description: MoonBit linear algebra fixture exercising matrix multiplication, Cholesky decomposition, inverse/linear solve, SVD, and eigen decomposition.

exports.name: eigenvalues_match
exports.description: Harness export that computes eigenvalues and eigenvectors for a diagonal matrix.

exports.name: svd_reconstructs
exports.description: Harness export that computes SVD and reconstructs the original matrix.

exports.name: inverse_and_solve_match
exports.description: Harness export that checks a 2x2 matrix inverse and linear-system solve.

exports.name: cholesky_reconstructs
exports.description: Harness export that computes Cholesky decomposition and verifies L * transpose(L).

tests.description: exercise numerical matrix algorithms across decomposition and solving paths
tests.notes: The matrix package returns MoonBit matrix objects, so each harness export performs a real numerical operation and compares complete reconstructed matrices or expected values with the package's approximation helpers.

steps.description: factor a symmetric positive-definite matrix with Cholesky
steps.notes: Uses the classic 3x3 SPD example [[4,12,-16],[12,37,-43],[-16,-43,98]] and checks that L * transpose(L) reconstructs the original matrix.
Inverts [[4,7],[2,6]], checks the expected inverse [[0.6,-0.7],[-0.2,0.4]], verifies A * inv(A) is identity, and solves for b=[1,0].

steps.description: decompose and reconstruct a matrix with SVD
steps.notes: Runs SVD on [[3,1],[1,3]] and verifies U * S * transpose(V) approximately equals the input.
Computes eigenpairs for diagonal [[3,0],[0,4]], checking eigenvalues 3 and 4 and identity eigenvectors.

source.description: Apache-2.0 moonbit-community/linalg matrix package compiled with a local export harness for corpus tests.

notes: The tests avoid opaque magic constants where possible by documenting the input matrices and the mathematical reconstruction being checked.
